title: HateSense: Hierarchical Sentiment Analysis Framework for Hate Speech Detection: Implementing Binary and Multiclass Classification Strategy
abstract: arXiv:2411.05819v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hate speech detectors must separate hateful posts from the far more common offensive but non-hateful ones, and two popular ideas for doing so are hierarchical (coarse-to-fine) classification and sentiment features. We revisit our earlier transformer-based framework, which combines both ideas, and test each component in a controlled study on two public benchmarks (Davidson et al., 24,783 tweets; HateXplain, 19,229 posts) with five random splits, validation-based tuning, and paired bootstrap tests. With linear models over word and character n-grams, the dominant-class-first hierarchy used in our framework lowered macro-F1 by 1.1-1.5 points relative to a flat classifier (p <= 0.007), and adding VADER sentiment features changed Davidson macro-F1 by at most 0.6 points, never significantly in the class-weighted settings. Class-weighted training was the only intervention with a large effect (+2.0 to +3.5 macro-F1 and +5.9 to +9.1 hate

translated_title: HateSense：用于仇恨言论检测的分层情感分析框架：实现二分类与多分类策略
translated_abstract: 仇恨言论检测器必须将仇恨性帖子与更为常见的冒犯性但非仇恨性帖子区分开来，实现这一目标的两个流行思路是分层（由粗到细）分类和情感特征。我们重新审视了我们早期结合这两种思路的基于Transformer的框架，并在两个公开基准数据集（Davidson等人的24,783条推文；HateXplain的19,229条帖子）上通过受控研究测试了每个组件，实验采用五次随机划分、基于验证集的调参以及配对自助法检验。结果表明，在使用基于词级和字符级n-gram的线性模型时，我们框架中采用的优势类别优先的分层方法相比平面分类器使宏平均F1降低了1.1至1.5个点（p <= 0.007），而添加VADER情感特征对Davidson数据集宏平均F1的影响最多为0.6个点，且在类别加权设置中从未达到统计显著水平。类别加权训练是唯一具有较大效果的干预措施（宏平均F1提升2.0至3.5个点，仇恨类召回率提升5.9至9.1个点）。
tldr: 该研究通过受控实验发现，分层分类和情感特征在仇恨言论检测中并未带来显著收益，而类别加权训练才是唯一能大幅提升性能的有效干预措施。
en_tdlr: Controlled experiments show that hierarchical classification and sentiment features provide no significant gains in hate speech detection, while class-weighted training is the only intervention with a large effect.
